title: Models, keys and costs
summary: The learner's own keys and model choices, and a running account of what the AI features cost.
description: The app has no account and no server of its own: the AI features run on the learner's keys, and the learner picks the models. Model ids go stale, so the app ships no default chat model and loads the catalogue live. Because the learner pays, every paid request is logged and shown.

requirements.text: The chat model is chosen from the catalogue loaded from OpenRouter; none is built in.
Every request to an outside service is made from the Rust core.
Speech always uses one fixed speech model, so the list of voices ships with the app.
The songwriter, the writing partner, pictures, looking at pictures and hearing speech each have their own model setting.
API keys can be moved to another device as a QR code that the other device scans.
Picture, vision and hearing models have built-in defaults; the learner can change them.
Every paid request is logged with the feature that made it.
Chat requests store the cost OpenRouter reports, including for streamed answers.
Suno songs store the credits kie.ai reports, converted at $0.005 a credit, once per task.
Speech is counted in clips and shown as unpriced, because the speech endpoint reports no price.
Settings shows costs for today, the last 7, 30 and 90 days and all time, per feature and day by day.
A model can be benchmarked on the app's own jobs (Polish, tool use, following the prompts), scored by rules and not by another model; each run is kept with its time and cost.
Diagnostics keeps a log the learner can read and pass on, holding only the newest entries.
